'''Wooof''' was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto]] who served the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Jabba placed the Nikto in charge of his fleet of [[skiff]]s and his [[sail barge]], the ''[[Khetanna]]''. In [[4 ABY]], Wooof was in the throne room of Jabba's [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when the droids [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]] delivered a [[hologram]] message to Jabba from the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]] bargaining for the freedom of his friend, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[Han Solo]].

After the Hutt refused Skywalker's offer, Wooof and other members of the court trapped the Rebel [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] after she freed Solo herself. The next [[Local day|day]], Wooof watched on as Skywalker killed Jabba's [[rancor]], [[Pateesa]], and escorted the Jedi Knight, Solo, and Chewbacca back to the throne room to be sentenced to death at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. Wooof then traveled to view the executions on board the ''Khetanna.'' During the ride, the Nikto took a refreshment from the now drink-serving R2-D2. Upon reaching the pit, Skywalker defeated the guards accompanying him and made his way onto the ''Khetanna''. Wooof rushed to the deck of the ''Khetanna'', only to be killed when Skywalker deflected Wooof's own [[blaster]] bolt back at the Nikto.

==Biography==
===Smuggler to fleet manager===
[[File:JabbaThroneRoom-RotJAVA.png|thumb|right|300px|Wooof was present in Jabba's throne room in 4 ABY.]]
A [[Kadas'sa'Nikto]]<ref name="DB" /> [[Homeworld|from]] the [[planet]] [[Kintan]], Wooof<ref name="Geektionary French">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' {{C|French version only}}</ref> was a former [[smuggler]] who worked for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Jabba placed the [[Nikto]] in charge of the fleet of [[skiff]]s Jabba kept at his [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the planet [[Tatooine]] as well as the crime lord's [[sail barge]] ''[[Khetanna]]''.<ref name="AEYNTK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref>

In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="SWGA" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Wooof was present<ref name="ROTJ" /> one morning<ref name="Beware" /> in the [[throne]] room of Jabba's Palace when the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] delivered a [[Hologram|holographic]] message to the Hutt from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] member and [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]]. Skywalker stated his intention to see the fellow Rebel [[Han Solo]], who was [[Prison|imprisoned]] in the palace within a block of [[carbonite]], set free. Wooof walked across the throne room while the Hutt declared that he would not bargain for Solo's freedom. The holographic Skywalker then gifted the two droids to Jabba, and they were escorted from the room to a<ref name="ROTJ" /> droid torture room<ref name="EV-9D9">{{Databank|ev-9d9|EV-9D9}}</ref> in the palace dungeons.<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> Shortly after, another Rebel, [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], arrived at the palace disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]], presenting<ref name="ROTJ" /> Solo's co-pilot and friend<ref name="EV-9D92">{{Databank|ev-9d9|EV-9D9}}</ref> [[Chewbacca]] as a bounty she wanted to collect on. Organa had actually come to the palace to free Solo from [[carbonite]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Jedi drawbacks===
{{Quote|Bring me Solo and the Wookiee. They will all suffer for this outrage!|Jabba, to his various servants|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
Wooof then took part in a trap that Jabba set for the Organa after the Hutt had been warned by the bounty hunter [[Boba Fett]] that Boushh was not who they seemed. Wooof and many other court members lay in wait behind curtains in the throne room later that night. After they had waited for an [[Standard hour|hour]],<ref name="Beware">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> the princess entered the room and freed Solo from the carbonite. After Jabba laughed at the pair, the curtains covering Jabba and his personnel were opened and Solo was quickly taken away. Under orders from the Hutt, Organa was brought to him by Lando Calrissian, an ally of Organa's disguised as a palace guard. Wooof and others followed them, staying as Jabba licked the Rebel's face.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:Luke-DL18.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Wooof advancing on Skywalker]]
The next morning,<ref name="Beware" /> Wooof was in Jabba's throne room, sitting in an alcove with<ref name="ROTJ" /> the [[Elom]] [[Tanus Spijek]],<ref name="Alien Archive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> when Luke Skywalker, let in after [[Mind trick|mind-tricking]] Jabba's [[majordomo]] [[Bib Fortuna]], arrived to negotiate the release of Solo. Wooof and other members of Jabba's court surrounded Skywalker as he demanded that his allies be set free. Jabba was not interested in Skywalker's proposal making Skywalker to use [[the Force]] to snatch [[Nizuc Bek]]'s<ref name="SWFC">{{ForceCollection|Nizuc Bek|star=2}}</ref> [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol|DL-18 blaster pistol]] from<ref name="ROTJ" /> his<ref name="SWFC" /> [[holster]]. The Hutt, however, opened the trapdoor in the throne room, and Skywalker fell into the pit<ref name="ROTJ" /> of [[Pateesa]], the [[Hutt]]'s pet [[rancor]].<ref name="Aftermath: Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> During the fight between the Jedi and the rancor, Skywalker was able to kill the beast by dropping a large gate on<ref name="ROTJ" /> his<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref> head. 

Along with the human<ref name="ROTJ" /> guard [[Fozec]],<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> Wooof retrieved Skywalker, Solo and Chewbacca and brought them up into the throne room. While Jabba sentenced them to death by being fed to the [[Sarlacc|sarlaac]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]], the Nikto pointed a DL-18 blaster pistol at Skywalker. After Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca were sentenced, Wooof and Fozec escorted Chewbacca out of the throne room and left with the rest of the court.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Death by deflection===
The Nikto later traveled on board the ''Khetanna'' to the Great Pit of Carkoon to witness Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca's execution. Wooof grabbed a beverage from the drink-serving R2-D2 and toasted with a human just before the droid bumped into C-3PO.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Upon reaching the pit, Wooof stood beside Boba Fett while Jabba gave the prisoners one last chance to beg for their lives. Things took a turn after Jabba ordered Skywalker be put over the edge of the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]] holding him and his allies into the sarlacc below. As the Jedi leapt back aboard, now armed with [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|his lightsaber]] which R2-D2 had launched to him, the Jedi began cutting down the guards around him as panic ensued on board the barge. Wooof and a Gamorrean rushed to the top deck of the ''Khetanna'',<ref name="ROTJ" /> as [[weapons master]] [[Vizam]]<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|packtype=Special Action Figure Set|pack=#152-154: Skiff Guard 3-Pack (Vadain, Vizam, & Brock Staraher)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Special-3-Action-Figures-Set-The-Vintage-Collection.asp}}</ref> fired at Skywalker and his friends.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Wooof and the Gamorrean removed a piece of material covering the sail barge's<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Me/7 double laser cannon]]<ref name="Fact">''[[Star Wars: Fascinating Facts]]''</ref> while Skywalker used a cargo skiff to jump onto the side of the ''Khetanna'', pulling himself up to the deck. Wooof fired at Skywalker with their [[blaster pistol]]; however, the Jedi deflected the shot with his blade, rebounding the bolt into Wooof, killing them. Soon after, Skywalker and Organa destroyed the ''Khetanna'' with the deck cannon and left with their allies.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Wooof had green skin, black eyes, and clawed fingers.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
Wooof wore a silver helmet, heavily distressed white shirt, a breastplate, [[leather]] [[Leather jerkin|jerkin]], a codpiece of the same leather, loincloth, ammunition [[bandolier]], and a wrist bracer.<ref name="Costumes">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref> The Nikto wielded a DL-18 blaster pistol during the Rescue of Han Solo.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Creation and Elstree Studios shoot===
{{Quote|It was easy because Phil's workshop was next door to me.|Nilo Rodis-Jamero describes the collaboration leading to the creation of the Wooof costume|<ref name="Costumes">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref>}}
[[File:WooofPolaroid-SWCOT.png|thumb|200px|On-set photo of Wooof]]
Wooof first appeared in the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which released on [[May 25]], [[1983]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The design for Wooof came from a [[1981]] illustration by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]], which labeled the character "Wooof #3" and had the character using a pirate-like sword. During the production of ''Jedi'', Wooof was considered to be an alien race, but was later re-dubbed "[[Klaatu]]" in reference to the [[1950s|1951]] film [[Wikipedia:The Day the Earth Stood Still|''The Day the Earth Stood Still'']]. The character's mask, hands, and costume were created through a collaboration between Rodis-Jamero's costume team and [[Phil Tippett]]'s creature design team.<ref name="Costumes" />

The costume consisted of a loincloth which production notes describe as being made from "crummy sheep skin," a chestplate made out of [[Wikipedia:Urethane|urethane]], heavy leather jerkin and codpiece of the same leather, ammunition bandolier, wrist bracer, and a helmet made by the [[Industrial Light & Magic]] plastic shop, which had a much rougher finish than the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] helmets.<ref name="Costumes" /> In the film, Wooof was played by an uncredited<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Michael Stevens|Mike Stevens]].<ref name="Costumes" /> The throne room scenes were filmed between [[January 25]] and [[February 8]], [[1982]] on Stage 8 at [[Elstree Studios]], and the sail barge interior shots were filmed on Stage 9 between [[February 9]] and [[February 11]].<ref name="Making of">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

===Canon and non-canon appearances===
====Identifications====
[[File:CCG JP Wooof.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A photo of Wooof was misidentified as Klaatu on the StarWars.com Databank.]]
In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, Wooof first appeared in ''[[Return of the Jedi: The Storybook Based on the Movie]]'', written by [[Joan D. Vinge]]<ref name="Storybook">''[[Return of the Jedi: The Storybook Based on the Movie]]''</ref> and released on [[May 12]], 1983.<ref name="Amazon UK-Paperback">{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=Return-Jedi-Storybook-Publisher-Publications/dp/B00SLU9N04|text=Return of the Jedi: Storybook: Written by Joan D. Vinge, 1983 Edition, Publisher: Futura Publications (Paperback)}}</ref> In the new ''Star Wars'' [[canon]], the character was first identified by name in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]],'' published by [[Dorling Kindersley]]<ref name="AEYNTK" /> on [[September 4]], [[2015]],<ref name="DK">{{DK|url=us/9781465437853-star-wars-absolutely-everything-you-need-to-know-journey-to-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know|nolive=1}}</ref> though the production<ref name="Costumes" /> name was first applied to the character in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity with the [[Jabba's Palace Limited]] set of cards from [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Wooof}}</ref> 

The [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry for [[Klaatu]], another Kadas'sa'Nikto in the employ of Jabba, incorrectly uses a photo of Wooof for illustration.<ref name="Klaatu DB">{{Databank|klaatu|Klaatu}}</ref> The [[Star Wars (2015) 55|fifty-fifth issue]] of the [[2015]] comic series ''[[Star Wars (2015)|Star Wars]]'', released on [[October 3]], [[2018]], has a variant cover<ref name="StarWars55">[[Star Wars (2015) 55|''Star Wars'' (2015) 55]]</ref> designed after the Kenner action figure of Wooof.<ref name="ActionFigure">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref> Both the issue and the toy misidentified the character.<ref name="StarWars55" /><ref name="ActionFigure" /> "[[Make Sail]]", an article published in ''[[Star Wars Insider 228]]''<ref name="Make Sail">{{InsiderCite|228|Make Sail}}</ref> and released on [[October 29]], [[2024]],<ref name="Titan">{{TitanComics|url=m/167-star-wars-insider-228|text=Star Wars Insider #228}}</ref> incorrectly identifies a [[LEGO]] Wooof minifigure as Klaatu.<ref name="Make Sail" />

====''Tatooine Rhapsody'' appearance====
Wooof appears in "[[Tatooine Rhapsody]]," an ambiguously canon short film in the ''[[Star Wars: Visions]]'' series<ref name="TR">{{Visions|Tatooine Rhapsody}}</ref> released on [[September 22]], [[2021]].<ref name="SWYouTube-STAR WARS: VISIONS | SPECIAL LOOK | DISNEY+">{{SWYouTube|b9Gr9gKFxpE|STAR WARS: VISIONS | SPECIAL LOOK | DISNEY+|sw_url=video/special-look-star-wars-visions}}</ref> In the short, Wooof, Boba Fett, a [[Human]] and [[Pagetti Rook]] interrupt a performance of the [[band]] [[Star Waver]] to capture band member [[Geezer Odajion]], on whom Jabba has placed a bounty. When the band fights back, Wooof gets repeatedly hit in the face with the drumsticks of the multi-limbed band member [[Lan Ar-Shoo]]. After other members of the band defeated Rook and the Human, Wooof was thrown off the stage and the band escaped in their [[starship]].<ref name="TR" />

After Fett was able to capture Odajion and take him to the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]] on Tatooine, the band negotiated a deal with Jabba to perform one song with the band member. before his planned execution. At the arena, Wooof aimed a [[blaster rifle]] at the back of Ar-Shoo as lead singer [[Jee Ken Tsokee]] informed Odajion of the fact that they would perform one song before Odajion's execution.<ref name="TR" />

====LEGO appearances====
Wooof appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'',<ref name="LSWTSS" /> which was released on [[2025|April 5]], [[2022]].<ref name="TSS Release">{{SW|url=news/lego-star-wars-the-skywalker-saga-is-here|text=''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'' Is Here!|date=2022-04-05|quote=The bricks strike back today.}}</ref> Wooof appears in two levels, "A Plan to Save Han" and "The Copa-Khetanna". In the former, Wooof and Klaatu appear as killable NPCs during Luke Skywalker and [[Gamorrean]] guard [[Jubnuk|Jubnuk's]] fight with Pateesa. In "The Copa-Khetanna", Wooof is a guard on the skiff taking Skywalker, Han Solo, and Chewbacca to their executions. Before Jabba gives the command to put the captives into position, Wooof is dispatched by the Rebel [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], who is disguised as one of Jabba's guards. The Wooof model is reused for enemies in that level and for the [[Kyber brick]] thief known as the "[[Kyber Swiper]]".<ref name="LSWTSS">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>

Wooof also appears in "[[Jabba's Halloween Bash]]", an animated [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO]] short part of the ''[[LEGO STAR WARS: Celebrate the Season]]'' series. In the short, which was released on [[October 5]], 2024, the Nikto attends a [[Halloween]] party held by Jabba on the ''Khetanna''. Wooof, standing next to the [[Gran]] [[Ree-Yees]] and the [[Chadra-Fan]] [[Kabe]], cheers on new arrival Boba Fett after he shoots a new expression into a [[pumpkin]] held by a [[Jawa]].<ref name="Jabba's Halloween">{{CelebrateTheSeason|Jabba's Halloween Bash}}</ref>

When [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] arrives to the party, Wooof, Ree-Yees, and Kabe all cower back as Vader approaches Jabba. The [[Sith Lord]] forces the Hutt off of his throne. An afraid Jabba makes his way to Fett and forces the bounty hunter to help him. Fett takes a drink away from Vader's hand, leading to the [[Sith]] being revealed to be Bib Fortuna after stumbling backwards into the real Vader. Wooof, Jabba, Fett, and others watched Fortuna be prodded into the Great Pit of Carkoon from the top of the ''Khetanna''. All watching on from the sail barge cheered when the majordomo fell off the skiff he was on.<ref name="Jabba's Halloween" />
